## :warning: Deprecations

- Deprecate `DataFluentAppender`, which is based on the unmaintained [fluent-logger for Java](https://github.com/fluent/fluent-logger-java/issues/99). Use `FluencyLogbackAppender` instead. It will be removed in 2.0.0 [sndyuk#78](https://github.com/sndyuk/logback-more-appenders/issues/78)

## :notebook_with_decorative_cover: Documentation

- Add a roadmap
